newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS TOUCH SOFTER, OFF LOWS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS TOUCH SOFTER, OFF LOWS.

text.p: London's nearby white sugar contracts consolidated on Wednesday, ending with pared losses.
October finished the evening 30 cents weaker at $324.90 per tonne, off a low of $323.90.
On Tuesday, the contract touched $323.10, finding good support after a string of losses.
December closed 10 cents softer at $322.00, off its low of $320.90.
Turnover was 1,053 lots, with 648 lots in October.
In Paris, October ended 40 cents firmer at $324.80 and December 10 cents higher at $321.60.
